1/G.goal: Explain the foundational landscape of extended reality by defining its core terms, mapping VR, AR, and MR on the reality-virtuality continuum, and assessing why XR is an important emerging field.
1/G.achieves: Equips the learner with the terminology, conceptual map, and motivation needed to engage with the course's case study and its hardware, human-factors, development, and optimization topics.

1/O1.goal: Explain extended reality as an umbrella term for immersive technologies and use the reality-virtuality continuum to position virtual, augmented, and mixed reality.
1/O1.achieves: Gives the learner a shared XR vocabulary and conceptual map for later course topics on hardware, human factors, and system development.

1/O2.goal: Explain why XR is an important emerging field by citing market growth, application domains, the metaverse, and demand for skilled practitioners.
1/O2.achieves: Supports the course aim of building XR systems with confidence by showing the practical and industry relevance of the later technical content.
